benefits.name: Complimentary Hilton Honors Silver Status
benefits.description: Automatic Hilton Honors Silver elite status, including a 20% points bonus on stays and a fifth reward night free on standard room reward stays booked with points.
benefits.terms: Status is maintained as long as the account remains open. Includes 20% bonus points on base earning and a free 5th night on award stays of 5+ nights paid entirely with points.

benefits.name: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 emergency assistance and coordination services while traveling, including medical and legal referrals, emergency cash wire coordination, and missing luggage assistance.
benefits.terms: Cardmember is responsible for the cost of any services rendered by third parties.

earningRates.terms: Direct bookings at Hilton hotels and resorts.
